form.summary: Some fields need a change before the connection can be saved:
form.name: Name
form.envHint: The class sets the colour of the strip above and how careful the app is. Production connections are locked until you unlock them.
form.uriHint: An amqp:// or amqps:// address, or the management URL. It may hold the user name and the password. What you type in the fields below wins over it. It is not shown again after you save.
form.hostHint: A name or an IP address, without a port. Leave it empty when the URI holds it.
form.amqpHostHint: Leave it empty to use the management host.
form.httpPortHint: Leave it empty for the usual port (15672, or 15671 with TLS).
form.amqpPortHint: Leave it empty for the usual port (5672, or 5671 with TLS).
form.tlsHint: The engine trusts the certificate authorities of the system. A certificate it does not trust fails the test; custom authorities cannot be set here yet.
form.pathPrefixHint: Only when the broker serves the management API under a path, for example /rabbitmq.
form.sameLogin: Use the same user name and password for AMQP
form.secretHintNew: Write-only: it is sent once and never shown again.
form.secretHintSet: A secret is stored. Leave this empty to keep it; type a new one to replace it. It is never shown.
form.secretHintNotSet: No secret is stored. It is sent once and never shown again.

error.invalid: This value is not valid here.
error.port: A port is a whole number from 1 to 65535.
error.pathPrefix: Start with a slash and leave out the one at the end, for example /rabbitmq.
error.secretAgain: The address changed, so the stored secret cannot follow it. Enter the secret again.

test.title: Tests
test.hintSaved: These tests use the saved connection and its stored login. Changes you have not saved are not tested.
test.hintDraft: These tests use what you typed, without saving it.
test.needAddress: Enter an address and a login first.
test.okHttp: The management API answered in {{ms}} ms: {{product}} {{version}}.
test.okAmqp: AMQP connection to {{host}}:{{port}}, virtual host {{vhost}}, opened and closed in {{ms}} ms.
test.ports: The broker says AMQP listens on {{plain}} (plain) and {{tls}} (TLS).
test.gates: Features that need an AMQP connection

HTTP_UNREACHABLE.title: The management API could not be reached
HTTP_UNREACHABLE.hint: Check the host and the port, and that the management plugin is enabled.

HTTP_TIMEOUT.title: The management API did not answer in time
HTTP_TIMEOUT.hint: The broker may be busy, or a firewall may be dropping the connection.

HTTP_EGRESS_DENIED.title: The engine may not connect to this address
HTTP_EGRESS_DENIED.hint: The outbound policy of the engine refuses it.

HTTP_TLS_UNTRUSTED.title: The certificate is not trusted
HTTP_TLS_UNTRUSTED.hint: The engine trusts the certificate authorities of the system only. Custom authorities cannot be set here yet.

HTTP_AUTH_REFUSED.title: The login was refused
HTTP_AUTH_REFUSED.hint: Check the user name and the password or token.

HTTP_MISSING_TAG.title: The user has no tag that allows the management API
HTTP_MISSING_TAG.hint: Give the user the monitoring, management or administrator tag.

HTTP_NOT_MANAGEMENT.title: This is not a management API
HTTP_NOT_MANAGEMENT.hint: Check the port and the path prefix.

HTTP_UNEXPECTED.title: The answer was not what a management API sends
HTTP_UNEXPECTED.hint: The engine's own words are below.

SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.title: The stored login could not be opened
SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Enter the secret again and save the connection.

AMQP_PORT_BLOCKED.title: Nothing answered on the AMQP port
AMQP_PORT_BLOCKED.hint: Check the host and the port, and that no firewall blocks it.

AMQP_EGRESS_DENIED.title: The engine may not connect to this address
AMQP_EGRESS_DENIED.hint: The outbound policy of the engine refuses it.

AMQP_TLS_UNTRUSTED.title: The certificate is not trusted
AMQP_TLS_UNTRUSTED.hint: The engine trusts the certificate authorities of the system only. Custom authorities cannot be set here yet.

AMQP_AUTH_REFUSED.title: The login was refused
AMQP_AUTH_REFUSED.hint: Check the user name and the password.

AMQP_VHOST_REFUSED.title: The virtual host was refused
AMQP_VHOST_REFUSED.hint: Check that the virtual host exists and that the user may use it.

AMQP_UNEXPECTED.title: The AMQP connection failed in an unexpected way
AMQP_UNEXPECTED.hint: The engine's own words are below.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.hint: The probe reads the management API of the broker with the stored login and keeps the answer in the engine. It asks questions; it changes nothing in the broker.
capabilities.notProbed: This connection has not been probed yet. Check the capabilities to read the broker.
capabilities.unreadable: The profile of this broker could not be read by this version of the app, so only the features the engine listed are shown.
capabilities.noGates: The engine listed no features, so what the broker allows is not known.
capabilities.caption: What the broker lets the app do

verification.unverifiedPatch: This broker patch version has not been through a conformance run; the verified version of the same minor release is the reference.
verification.unverifiedMinor: No version of this broker's minor release has been through a conformance run. What the app shows is unconfirmed.
verification.unknownBuild: This broker build could not be identified, so none of the app's broker behaviour has been verified for it.
